india.one_line: India sees AI infrastructure boost, venture fund launch, while Anthropic files for IPO.

themes.title: Anthropic files Nasdaq IPO
themes.text: Anthropic filed a Form S‑1 to list on Nasdaq under ticker ANT, reporting $16.3 billion revenue in the first half of 2026 and $131.7 billion in cash or cash equivalents.

stories.headline: Anthropic files S‑1 for Nasdaq IPO, reporting $16.3 billion H1 revenue

themes.title: Tata Communications builds AI fibre network
themes.text: Tata Communications will invest up to $450 million to construct a 10,000‑km high‑speed fibre network linking AI data‑centre corridors, starting with the Mumbai‑Pune‑Hyderabad‑Chennai route, targeting hyperscalers, AI platforms, enterprises and a market exceeding $1 billion.

stories.headline: Tata Communications to invest $450 million in 10,000 km AI network in India
Tata Communications to spend $450 million on 10,000 km AI‑ready fibre network in India

themes.title: Unacademy founders start AI fund
themes.text: Unacademy co‑founders Gaurav Munjal and Roman Saini are raising a ₹700 crore venture fund, Longshot Capital, to back AI and deep‑tech startups, aiming to invest in 25‑28 seed and pre‑Series A companies with cheques of $500,000‑$1.5 million, with a first close expected in January 2027.

stories.headline: Unacademy founders launch ₹700 cr AI and deeptech fund Longshot Capital
